hook.text: The Tibetan Book of the Dead describes the bardo—an in-between state lasting 49 days after death.

buildup.text: The soul encounters peaceful and wrathful deities. Each vision tests clarity. Panic traps you; calm frees you.

discovery.text: The deities aren't real. They're projections of your own mind. You're judged by your inner landscape.

twist.text: Liberation is possible at every stage. Even after death, you can awaken—if you recognize the visions as illusion.

climax.text: Tibetan Buddhism makes death a final meditation. Your afterlife is shaped by how clearly you can see.

quiz.question: How long do the bardo states last in Tibetan Buddhism?
